boundary: Development strategy rules, not historical measurements or approved release content. Carry the five inherited campaign-capacity meters from Fan Yang without refilling. They represent remaining coalition capacity, not a physical northern grain store teleported to Chen. Chapter resources remain a separate historical record. Soldier backing is not a headcount.

choices.reason: Supply the agreed grain convoy but retain an escort reserve; partners receive less support than requested.
Send provisions and detach a willing escort. Allied support improves, but the escort is no longer locally available.
Verify a route at the cost of time and delayed support; no complete battlefield knowledge or extra food is created.
Admit that no new support can be promised. Retain existing resources but lose allied confidence; this remains possible with no supplies.
Feed and organize arrivals, earning civil backing while stretching the guard. Their evacuation later needs extra grain.
Spend time and allied goodwill arranging shared reception. A previous shared ledger reduces the verification time, not the food bill.

answers.reason: The Chen shared ledger lets partners check an established record instead of rebuilding it.

choices.reason: Do not expand reception. Existing people stay accounted for; outsiders receive no new shelter promise.
Provision the escort and give households time to leave. Extra arrivals increase the load; a retained reserve avoids the additional assembly delay.

answers.reason: The retained escort is already positioned, so no extra assembly time is spent.
The people admitted at the reception shelter must also be provisioned for evacuation.

choices.reason: Retain an organized guard while narrowing the escort commitment. Those left behind do not become recorded rescues.
Avoid a single blocked column by separating groups. Mutual support weakens; a rendezvous is not a guaranteed reunion.
Take time to distribute verifiable claims; civilian confidence improves. Unknown names remain unknown.
Carry the existing records without copying. The identifying records and their exposure risk remain; this costs no newly promised resources.
Remove identifying information but weaken some claims to repayment. Names cannot later be reconstructed without new evidence.
Sustain a rendezvous with provisions left after the first wait, civil consent and a willing guard. Earlier losses remain unresolved.
Provision one organized departure. This cannot summon missing people or promise food beyond that departure.

End central command. Orderly separation needs at least one grain and backing of at least two from civilians, allies or soldiers. Otherwise the forecast is loss of cohesion, not a peaceful return home.

reaction.en: You give the directions you can verify, but cannot supply a common departure. People begin leaving before the accounts are settled. Their routes and survival are not known; no deaths are silently invented.
reaction.zh-Hans: 你交代了能够确认的路，却筹不出有序分行的支撑。账还没核完，已经有人离开。他们去了哪里、是否平安，尚无消息；这里不凭空判定任何人死亡。

recovery.en: Review the earlier commitments or replay from a preserved checkpoint. Continuing later must retain unresolved people and debts rather than restore the whole group.
recovery.zh-Hans: 可回看此前的承诺，或从保留的节点重试。日后继续时必须保留未明的去向与欠账，不能把整队人自动补回。
